lemma tested_power (v:(fork n f).Leaf→S.Tag)(w:J→S.Tag)(m:ℕ):
    ∀ᶠ r:ℝ in 𝓝[>]0,∀ (s:(fork n f).Inner→ℝ)(z:Tree.Plot (fork n f)) (y:J→E4),Accept r M η s z → Buffer z y δ→
    Kernel.cardPanel z y ∈ Orbits.guardZone U R m ∧ ‖Kernel.normData U R z v m y w‖ ≤ toll (wages v) ε (m+1:ℝ) s ∧ ∀ q:Viewers U, ‖Kernel.pipe U R z v q m y w‖ ≤ toll (wages v) ε (m+1:ℝ) s:=by

proof_context.conclusion: Eventually in `r`, for every accepted geometry with spectators buffered by `δ`, the algebra-valued remainder and every viewer's scalar are at most `toll` at `m+1`.

lemma all_kernel (m:ℕ): ∀ᶠ i in l,(∀ q:Viewers U,‖kernel U R z v m y w i q‖ ≤ Tree.toll (wages v) ε (m+1:ℝ) (s i)) ∧ ‖output U R z v m y w i‖ ≤ Tree.toll (wages v) ε (m+1:ℝ) (s i):=by
     have he:= universalize (p:=fun i q=> ‖kernel U R z v m y w i q‖ ≤ Tree.toll (wages v) ε (m+1:ℝ) (s i)) (passes_kernel U R h hT v hg hs ht h₀ hε w hp hy m)
     filter_upwards [he, space_kernel (v:=v) U R h hT hg (y:=y) hp hy] with i he hi
     exact ⟨he,glance_contract U ((norm_nonneg _).trans (he none)) |>.2 fun q=>by unfold output; rw [formula_seen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hi.1 hi.2]; exact he q⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Along the refined filter, `kernel` for every viewer and the algebra norm `output` are at most `toll (m+1)`.

lemma buffer_stage {δ:ℝ}{z:L→I→E4}{y:L→J→E4}(hδ:0<δ)(hp:∀ᶠ i in l,Buffer (z i) (y i) δ):Intervals l T 0 z y ∧ Kept l T 0 y:=by
     have hv(a)(ha:0<a):∀ᶠ i in l,Real.exp ((-a)*T i)<δ:=(RateIs.exp (-a) hT).tends (neg_neg_of_pos ha) hT |>.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ)
     refine ⟨fun r hr=> ((hv r hr).and hp).mono fun i ⟨hi,h'⟩ u v=>hi.trans_le (h'.1 u v), fun r hr=>((hv r hr).and hp).mono fun i ⟨he,hi⟩ u v huv=> he.trans_le (hi.2 u v huv)⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Buffered spectators give `Intervals` and `Kept` at height zero, so they add no exponent.
